'''Vexx's Crew''' was a crew of [[Human/Legends|Humans]] that worked for the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and gunslinger [[Vexx]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], a number of them accompanied Vexx to the [[Jiguuna Spaceport|spaceport]] in the town of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]. As Vexx prepared to board a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] in one of the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport's]] hangars, a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] seeking to claim a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Vexx's head attacked the members of the crew guarding Vexx, defeating many of them and successfully [[Death/Legends|killing]] the smuggler.

==Description==
Vexx's Crew was a criminal group that worked for [[Vexx]],<ref name="Sending a Message" /> a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] and champion gunslinger,<ref name="Gauntlet">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Gauntlet|Hutta}}</ref> for whom a steady supply of henchmen and thugs was always available. The group included a variety of [[Human/Legends|Human]] members, including twelve [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]], six thugs,<ref name="Sending a Message" /> three hired guns,<ref name="Clearing Out">{{TORcite|type=bonus|Clear out Vexx's Safehouse|Nal Hutta}}</ref> and [[Vexx's bodyguard]]. The [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] used a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in combat while the thugs, mercenaries,<ref name="Sending a Message" /> and hired guns all used [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].<ref name="Clearing Out" />

==History==
Vexx and his crew were active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].<ref name="Sending a Message" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Vexx spent [[Time/Legends|time]] in the town of [[Jiguuna]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] after robbing fifteen Imperial pay stations, which resulted in a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] being placed upon his head. While in Jiguuna the smuggler stayed in a [[Vexx's Safehouse|safehouse]], where he used a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to book tickets on a [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] leaving from [[Jiguuna Spaceport]] the next [[Standard day/Legends|day]]. The following day he left the safehouse<ref name="Gauntlet" /> with three hired guns inside acting as guards, but while he was out a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] seeking information on Vexx entered the structure and [[Death/Legends|killed]] the three men inside in order to make sure they did not escape and report back to Vexx.<ref name="Clearing Out" /> The hunter then discovered the datapad and learned of Vexx's shuttle booking.<ref name="Gauntlet" />

Prior to his shuttle taking off, Vexx spent [[Time/Legends|time]] working on the vehicle in [[Hangar 01|one]] of the hangars at the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]<ref name="Last Flight">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Last Flight|Hutta}}</ref> while guarded by twelve mercenaries, six thugs, and his bodyguard. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] then entered the hangar and attacked the crew, killing at least fifteen of them in order to send a message that signing on with outlaws like Vexx was a death sentence as long as the hunter was around.<ref name="Sending a Message" /> The bounty hunter then confronted Vexx himself and killing the smuggler.<ref name="Last Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vexx's Crew first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively-multiplayer roleplaying game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. Members of the crew must be killed by the player in the bounty hunter class bonus missions "Sending a Message"<ref name="Sending a Message" /> and "Clear out Vexx's Safehouse".<ref name="Clearing Out" />
